findings.finding: (a) 'a short 003/004/005 form within such a line's sentence' is not deterministic. Read literally, it leaves out short-form-only lines, yet the design quotes several: BH:43-45 ('edit 003'), BH:95 ('005 packages'), BH:216 ('003 resolves'), BH:251-253, NQ:44 ('edit003'), NQ:242-245 ('004's installed worker ... packet004') and NQ:256 ('Product003'). The same pattern also catches other families, for example HO:docs/alpha-2/CONFORMANCE_REFERENCE_MEASUREMENT.md:52-53, where 'retired001/002/003, the current004' are CONF-PERF packets. (b) The vocabulary has no disposition for hits that assign only kept items, or grants that stay true: COR:102, TLC:540, TLC:557, BH:40-42, CUSTODY_HANDOFF_REPAIR.md:94-96 and :149-151 (client and custody), CREDENTIAL_LIFECYCLE_REPAIR.md:169, SUCCESSOR_INVENTORY_REPAIR.md:79-81. Labelling these NOT_OWNERSHIP is inaccurate, and S1-15 forbids quoting them.
findings.requiredChange: Define the search exactly: the long-form regex; a short-form regex with a family-context rule (for example a CONF-LIVE id within the same paragraph, or a closed list of glued forms such as packet004, edit003, Product003, same003-owned, packets003-006); the file set as pathspecs with every exclusion; and the line unit. Add a disposition such as UNCHANGED_TRUE (assigns kept items, or path, stage or command grants that stay true). Give NOT_OWNERSHIP a closed reason vocabulary (STATUS_LINE, DIGEST_PIN, ORDERING_PREREQUISITE, STAGE_OR_COUNT, IDENTIFIER_INDEX, REVIEW_HISTORY).

findings.finding: 'Re-running the declared search over the base gives exactly the recorded hits' needs a listing of every file under docs/, architecture/ and task-packets/ at the base, and their base bytes. read(path) gives neither a listing nor protection against drift. Named catalogs (MDP, 00-harness-engineering.md, task-packets/README.md, DS) change after the base, and the layer runs at later eras. Scale from this review: 2386 long-form lines in 278 files (542 in 92 authority files, 578 in unified-requirement-dispositions.json), plus about 124 short-form lines and 19 short-form-only files. The 278 hit files alone come to 64 MB.
findings.requiredChange: State where the base listing and bytes come from. Either run the full re-search at the contract build and in a model fixture, with the layer checking the recorded hits' files by digest (pinned) or presence (named), or bind the scanned file list by digest. Allow file-level dispositions for PINNED and NAMED files, so the record is not thousands of per-line rows.
